# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> This is a fantastic 3-bedroom semidetached residence with large detached garage to the rear. Located to the front of this mature estate, within walking distance of all the amenities that Mullingar town has to offer. The property is brought to the market in excellent condition having recently been redecorated throughout.
